payload.title: Vehicle Builder Socket Prep UX / 차량 메시 소켓 준비 UX
payload.next_action: VSPUX-P0-02: implement Recipe-free Quick Socket Prep in existing SCFVehicleBuilderTab as minimal working UI prototype, NOT a final USER-accepted layout. Keep UI-only Slate section builders (mesh picker, wheel roles, dynamic Hardpoint location category) separate from stable Tab-local mode/mesh/category state, live socket-name and collision validation, and existing transaction-based physical socket create/open handlers; no widget slot-index/address or construct-time socket-name capture as action authority. Current category Top/Front/LeftSide etc. are extensible (not 3D coordinates); source via GetStandardHardpointCategories, and keep HP_<Category>_<NN> parser/consumer contract. Preserve Quick refresh/return, existing Step 1-8/Recipe state, current role-name display/copy/add equivalence, existing asset/socket, Save0. VSPUX-P0-03 focused/source-build validation; VSPUX-P0-04 USER reviews actual Editor layout, then make surgical UI-only layout adjustments and revalidate with focused regression + editor smoke. Do not claim UI Acceptance before visual USER review. Source/Asset/Build/Automation/PIE all Not Run.

provenance.resolution_basis: USER explicitly defers final Slate layout until viewing actual implemented UI, and requires subsequent layout adjustments to be safe. Existing SCFVehicleBuilderTab uses CommonPageScrollBox, HardpointPlanningHost->SetContent and named handlers, but BuildRequiredWheelSocketRow captures potentially stale SocketName at construction. v0.1.4 adds UI builder vs stable handler separation, live click validation, Tab-local UI-independent state, layout-only diff/testing constraints, P0-04 USER layout review and focused regression. This was a docs-only correction; source/build/Automation/PIE not executed.
